title: Deployment cap-2 solver feasibility profile
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: A second postflop raise per street will materially increase exact live legal-mask/history support by supplying targets at raise-versus-raise decisions, and a low-bucket exact-grid tree will fit the 128GB host well enough to measure convergence and plan a tractable teacher.
material_change: Add explicit deployment_v55 SRP/3BP 200bb cap-2 configs shared by solving, range loading, preflop context, and conversion; test tree/action contracts; then profile one deterministic board at increasing buckets and iterations before any distillation.
baseline: Cap-1 four-board teacher covers 70.34% of live postflop public shape+mask but only 39.55% of history+pot+SPR+mask; SRP cap-2 betting tree has 1,073,360 action nodes versus 223,924 at cap-1 (4.79x).

code.provenance_gap: Historical record predates automatic patch/source-manifest capture; the exact dirty worktree cannot be reconstructed post hoc.

notes: Fixed compact/deployment aggressive-action count split and exact semantic ALLIN replay. All 127,442 cap2 rows now have zero state/target/replay mismatches. Escalate same board b4 from i10 to i50 to measure sampled-history saturation.
b4/i50 remains materially different from i10 but fits comfortably. Escalate the identical seeded board to i200 to measure convergence and upper-bound one-board resource needs.
Discovered and fixed a single-Map 2^23 converter ceiling hidden by a broad catch. Sharded loading increased i200 SRP compact output from 99,417 to 334,367 rows and restored live coverage.

Post-hoc infrastructure repair refreshed verifiable wall-time and artifact-integrity fields. The exact historical dirty-worktree patch/source manifest and placeholder commands cannot be reconstructed without falsifying provenance; the record explicitly preserves that gap.

result.summary: Exact-grid cap2 is hardware-feasible at b4/i200 (28.24M SRP infosets, 678s solve, 17.6GB peak) and raises comparable live public-shape+mask coverage from 94.19% to 96.55%, but i200 remains materially unconverged (i50-to-i200 mean TV .117; root TV .220).
result.conclusion: Cap2 is a useful future supplemental topology, not yet a full replacement teacher. The profile exposed a more urgent data bug: all prior deep SRP conversions silently truncated at 8,388,608 unique keys because a single V8 Map capacity exception was swallowed. Fixing that recovers most missing rows without new solve compute.
result.next_step: Reconvert the existing eight-board b8/i200 cap1 SRP and 3BP checkpoints with the sharded loader and deployment raise-count contract, validate every row, retrain the same H64 dual-mask adapter, and compare on the identical 4096/10000 mirror gates before any Slumbot.
